findings.title: Loyalty points are now awarded per cent instead of per dollar
findings.trigger: points_for (not touched by this PR) still does int(cart.subtotal()), which assumed a Decimal dollar subtotal. Cart.subtotal() now returns integer cents, so a $42.50 cart yields 4250 instead of 42. place_order credits this on every order.
findings.impact: Every order credits 100 times the intended points (times the tier multiplier), inflating balances customers can redeem. Convert with cart.subtotal() // 100 and add a test that uses a real Cart.
